02 / Built for the work between machines.

LESS GUESSWORK. MORE CONTROL.
[⇄]

The commands you know.

Keep your rsync workflow. Copy locally, push or pull over SSH, and mirror with familiar flags.

xs -az src/ host:/backup/
[▥]

Many files. In parallel.

An engine built for trees of small files. See active file progress and the rate of completed small files together.

--jobs=8 --progress
[↳]

Pick up where you left off.

With partial transfers enabled, matching destination prefixes are verified before xsync sends the remaining bytes.

-P / --partial --progress

03 / GET STARTED

Your next transfer.
A little more transparent.

Clone the repository and build xsync with a C++20
compiler, CMake, zstd, xxHash, and ICU. macOS and Linux.

Read the manual ↗
CLONE AND BUILD · MACOS
brew install git cmake ninja zstd xxhash icu4c
git clone https://github.com/s4njee/xsyncv4.git
cd xsyncv4
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
cmake --build build
build/xs -aP src/ dst/
↳ Already built? Add --progress to your next transfer.
